questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Exchange of culture and religion

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det er en svær hjemmeside at navigere i, og det er svært at finde informationer om campus, undervisning og fag

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der kommer et fint velkomstbrev, men det kommer meget sent. Is i maven!

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: AirBnB og venners venner

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det kan være dyrt at bo i Istanbul, men der findes gode, billigere muligheder, hvis du bor med andre. Pas på du ikke bliver narret til at betale for meget

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det er egentlig en fin proces at vælge fag, efter en uges tid kan du vælge om, hvis de ikke lever op til dine forventninger

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der er et godt buddy-system med studerende, der står klar til at hjælpe med anything

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Nogle fag blev ikke oprettet, men med hjælp fra andre studerende fandt jeg tilsvarende fag

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Find en masse fag (også tilvalg) som lyder interessante, som du kan få forhåndsgodkendt. Det er en lang proces at få forhåndsgodkendt nye fag, og jeg er stadig i gang med den proces, selvom jeg rejser hjem igen om en uge...

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er generelt et lavere niveau på universitetet, og det mærkes i de studerendes generelle engagement i undervisningen.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Lavt niveau, men visse lærere har højt ambitionsniveau for de studerende.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Ikke nær så meget interaktiv læring, og der er generelt et meget lavt interaktionsniveau fra de studerende. Hvis du gerne vil lære noget, kan du sagtens det, men vær forberedt på, at du måske er den eneste

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Media Culture, Broadcasting and New Media, Film Genres, World Cinema, Digital Design II

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil anbefale alle fag på New Media - de har et højt niveau, underviserne er engagerede, og der er mulighed for at producere en masse selv, som du er tilfreds med

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Det koster lidt at ansøge om residence permit; tyrkisk skat, telefonregning og papirarbejde. Sæt tid og penge af til det

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er generelt billigere at handle i supermarket, især frugt og grønt er meget billigt. Det kan være dyrt at spise ude, og generelt er priserne steget selv på et halvt år. Offentlig transport er billig så snart du får et Istanbulcard til studerende, så koster et abonnement 600 lira om måneden (omkring 100 kr)

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er en introuge planlagt af en gruppe studerende, og de planlægger sociale aktiviteter, ture ud af byen osv. Jeg gjorde ikke meget brug af det, men det virker som om, at mange har glæde af det

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag til de events som du orker, find dine mennesker og brug det netværk, der bliver givet i starten

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville ønske jeg selv havde taget på flere ture ud af byen i weekenderne, men jeg elskede også at blive i byen og være turist i egen by, når der ikke var skole

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Der er generelt en ret stor interesse fra de lokale studerende, så hvis du orker, er der rig mulighed for at få tyrkiske venner.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Vær åben og nysgerrig og hav tålmodighed. Alle har travlt men gør deres bedste

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De studerende er generelt yngre (19-20 år), så det kan evt være en udfordring at finde et fælles ståsted med de tyrkiske studerende

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Åbenhed, gæstfrihed og nysgerrighed beskriver meget fint tyrkerne. Alle er opmærksomme på dig, og det kan godt være lidt overvældende med opmærksomhed til tider. Husk, at du gerne må sige fra.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær åben og nysgerrig og lær at sætte grænser. Selvom alle er interesseret i dig, er det helt okay også at have brug for at være alene

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hav en god opsparing med. Det kan være dyrt at tage på ture, tage på museer, tage ud og spise osv, selvom man også kan leve billigt i Istanbul

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De mennesker du møder bliver din familie. Vælg dem med omhu og pas godt på dem <3

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Systemer systemer systemer. Der er altid papirarbejde, der skal fikses. Slå koldt vand i blodet når det gælder dit residence permit, det skal nok løse sig, men det tager bare tid.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
